notes:
Lead profile: small devtools startup building a context-aware code assistant for enterprise IDEs. Inbound via self-serve sign-up and product-led trial. Interested primarily in Hosted API — want quick launch without ops overhead.

Key asks / quotes: 
- "We need the assistant to understand whole repo state (tens of thousands of tokens across files) — can your hosted API realistically support 100k+ context?"
- "Rate limits caused 429s in the sandbox; need predictable per-user bursts for interactive editor sessions."

Tech requirements summary: long-session context + streaming responses for low-latency UX; Node and Go SDK examples; support for prefix caching/pinned KV cache; token billing and cost estimator to model per-seat pricing. No mandate for private deployment — public cloud fine for now. SSO later (ok to require SAML). Audit logging + KMS for workspace secrets preferred.

Trial usage so far: a handful of devs ran ~150k tokens total across several sessions; observed latency ~300ms for 512-token completions (want <200ms target if possible). They used the default model and tried streaming — partial responses work but reconnects cause state loss.

Commercial: small ARR expectation first year (pilot ~1-3k USD/mo), but runway to upsell to Dedicated if latency/cost needs grow. Very cost sensitive at SMB stage; wants transparent per-token math.
